context: Kenji and Ren ride the train to work and chat.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: レン君、電車、混んでる、今朝。
lines.en: Ren-kun, the train was packed this morning.
lines.style: Warm, gentle opening. Casual observation delivered with easy affection. Soft tone, unhurried. The comfort of sharing a small complaint with someone you're glad to see.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、皆、出勤時間、ですね。
lines.en: Yeah — everyone commutes at the same time, don't they.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Respectful but natural, not formal. A small nod in the voice. Acknowledging the shared reality without making a big thing of it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.en: But I'm glad we're doing this together.
lines.style: Tender sincerity. Slight pause before the line — letting it land. Warm but understated. The kind of thing he means more than he usually says.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: Let's both do our best at work today.
lines.style: Bright but genuine, not forced. Respectful in tone but steady. A small lift at the end — encouragement without needing to be loud about it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 今日、忙しい、一日になりそう。
lines.en: Today's going to be a busy one, I think.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Looking ahead without dread. Calm acceptance of what's coming. Warm closing — including Ren in the reality of the day.
